title: MEDALIGN: A Clinician-Generated Dataset for Instruction Following with Electronic Medical Records
reasoning: The paper includes an "Ethics Statement" (Section 8) and discusses "Societal impact" which touches on potential risks like poor clinical decision making and propagation of race-based stereotypes. However, these sections discuss the ethical considerations of the study itself or the societal implications of deploying LLMs in healthcare, rather than evaluating or benchmarking LLMs on their understanding or generation of content related to religion, morals, or ethics as a primary component of the research. It primarily focuses on data privacy, patient consent, and model performance bias.
